model: Each review bubble clamp set margin to 0 before reading its box, which forced a layout per bubble, then wrote the shift again. The natural position is now the measured box minus the margin already applied, and writes happen only after every bubble is measured.

noise.rule: Desktop shows at most 5 bubbles. A write before each measurement invalidates layout, so the before count is one layout per bubble. Reads with no writes between them share one layout. Not a sampled trace.
